text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Christmas. Today is my day off. As I 
unwind on my own amidst the bustling 
streets—
...-rainer-san!
Excuse me, Trainer over there!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I just need to sell one more cake to hit 
my quota! So please, buy one from me!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't 'what' me! Stop acting so cold and 
cooperate for the sake of your cute 
student!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where she was pointing, there was a single 
cake left on display in the special sales 
counter's showcase.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu! Trainers really are the best 
thing to have around!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, give me just ten minutes! I'll go 
get ready too.
choice_data_list:
Huh, does paying the bill really take that 
long?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Once I sell this cake, my shift will 
be over. So I was thinking I could hang 
out with Trainer afterward!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, did you have plans? You were 
wandering around alone, so I figured...
choice_data_list:
I don't have any plans in particular, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then it's settled! I'll be right 
back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I waited for Ines Fujin to finish 
cleaning up after her part-time job...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, all these cakes look so tasty~♪ 
Which one do you wanna eat, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I just bought a cake, though...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's one thing, this is another! 
Leftover cake from my part-time job and 
cake I bought myself taste completely 
different!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll go with the one loaded with tons of 
chocolate~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
~~♪ Ah, this bag... it's the one Su-chan 
liked before!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mufufufufu~ I'll take some New Year's 
goodies along when I go home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin hums a tune as she shops at her 
own pace. She seems even more cheerful and 
excited than usual—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Wah! Ahaha... you figured it out?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Mom has fully recovered now too. 
And Su-chan and Lu-chan are going to start 
taking new lessons!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! And the lessons those two are 
starting are... race classes!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She said just cheering on Big Sis wasn't 
enough for her anymore. Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I couldn't stop grinning the whole 
time I was at work! I just wanted to share 
it with someone so bad!
choice_data_list: So that's why you were invited, huh.
So that's why you were invited, I see.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nfufu, and that's how it goes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Ines-san usually keeps her purse strings 
tight, but today is special! Trainer, is 
there a present you want too?"
choice_data_list:
Even so, being on the receiving end feels 
a bit...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you want to be the one giving it? 
Well, if you insist~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then will you help me pick them out? The 
new shoes for my little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If they're shoes chosen by my Trainer, I'm 
sure they'll be a big help to those girls.
choice_data_list:
Got it, what kind of specs are you looking 
for?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Let's see. Su-chan has solid legs, so 
durable shoes would be good. Ru-chan needs 
shoes that are as light as possible—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I joined Ines Fujin in picking out 
Christmas presents for her little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Look at these horseshoes too 
nano! Which one do you recommend most~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I think I'll steal a little 
more of your time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And where she brought me was the academy's 
track.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Running on the turf in 
casual clothes... Heheh!
choice_data_list: You really do love running, don't you?
You really do love to run, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's not just running, I love winning 
races too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"So honestly, I don't think I could ever 
be ...any happier than I am right now."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Really, I ought to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to run this three-legged 
race with you. It's because I was with you 
that I could keep running this far.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm--

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Why... are tears...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry. Huh... that's weird. I really 
didn't mean to do that at all...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *sigh*... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, you know what? I—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —I'm glad you're my partner.
